resolved_findings.finding: The catalog source parameter was empty, so release preflight inspected sc_demo and produced 137 source-menu failures; no active release snapshot existed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added an explicit local.dev product-release preparation entry, bound source/platform identities to sc_dev_demo, and created/verified active snapshot 4 through EditionReleaseSnapshotService.

resolved_findings.finding: After an enable request, the immediate disable readback could observe a stale registry-cached true value and return INTERNAL_ERROR instead of committing the disable.
resolved_findings.resolution: Clear the registry cache after the parameter row write completes and added a focused stale-cache regression.

resolved_findings.finding: After moving the authoritative release to sc_platform_control, sc_dev_demo had no active runtime release snapshot. The enterprise scenario catalog therefore returned ACTIVE_RELEASE_SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND and no rows.
resolved_findings.resolution: The governed prepare entry now creates a tenant runtime snapshot in sc_dev_demo from the same approved policy artifact and exact revision, while the independent platform control snapshot remains the authoritative product release.

resolved_findings.owner: P1 enterprise initialization plus P0 effective delivery
resolved_findings.finding: The native enterprise.setup override removed enablement_scope=enterprise_initialization, and effective delivery only generated internal actions for scenes already present in business navigation. The five setup actions therefore never reached scene_ready_contract.
resolved_findings.resolution: Preserve the initialization lifecycle on the native scene projection and admit that explicit lifecycle scope into internal-action resolution without promoting unscoped business scenes.

resolved_findings.finding: The Odoo partner_autocomplete extension rewrites res.company name and vat to field_partner_autocomplete at effective-view generation time. The contract registry omitted that native widget, so the whole enterprise information form stopped with PROFESSIONAL_COMPONENT_UNREGISTERED.
resolved_findings.resolution: Declare field_partner_autocomplete in the semantic registry as an explicit generic visual fallback while preserving the native widget identity and field editability.

resolved_findings.finding: The personnel form published sc_profile_document_ids context as a raw Python expression string. The one2many consumer requires a resolved dictionary and stopped the create form with native_modifier.context_operand.
resolved_findings.resolution: Resolve native field context expressions against final record facts, publish the executable dictionary in context, preserve contextRaw, normalize many2one ids, and apply the result consistently to field nodes and owning widget descriptors. Unresolved expressions still fail closed.

resolved_findings.owner: P0 smart_core native command parser consumed by P1 runtime user management
resolved_findings.finding: The generic create-default merge injects Odoo Command.SET for company_ids. The native command parser accepted only exact int instances and rejected the Command IntEnum, blocking normal user creation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Accept non-boolean integer command enums and normalize the operation to int; added a runtime user management regression using Command.set.
